scope.selection: Unreviewed exact SFA records at Changi Airport Terminal 3 #B2-03, selected as the strongest overlap between prior temporary-closure and staff-area access signals. Excludes all 20 CAG T1/T4 records reviewed in Refresh135. Checked licence IDs against prior refresh*_closures_access_20261019 snapshots.

sources.observed: Official release states T1/T3 reopened to public on 2021-09-01; dedicated staff dining area at T3B2 is adjacent to Kopitiam food court; visitors may freely visit T3B2. Staff zone is explicitly narrower than whole floor.
Official COVID-19 response described temporary T3 B2 public closure; F&B outlets were to reopen for takeaway to airport employees only. Dated, temporary restriction, not evidence of current closure.
Current CAG terms define airport as public areas of T1-T4; does not determine access to an exact tenant/staff dining zone.
